parameters.query:
SELECT
  e.id AS equipment_id,
  e.serial_number,
  e.model_number,
  e.equipment_type,
  f.id AS facility_id,
  f.name AS facility_name,
  fa.email AS admin_email,
  fa.full_name AS admin_name
FROM zipsafe.equipment e
JOIN zipsafe.facilities f ON f.id = e.facility_id
JOIN zipsafe.facility_admins fa ON fa.facility_id = f.id AND fa.is_primary = TRUE
WHERE e.id = {{ $json.equipment_id }}
